lemma Typing.progress (der : Typing [] t τ) : t.Value ∨ ∃ t', t ⭢βᵛ t' := by
  generalize eq : [] = Γ at der
  induction der <;> subst eq
  case var mem => contradiction
  case app t₁ _ _ t₂ l r ih_l ih_r =>
    right
    cases ih_l rfl l with
    | inl val_l =>
        cases ih_r rfl r with
        | inl val_r =>
            obtain ⟨σ, t₁', eq⟩ := val_l.canonical_form_abs
            exists t₁' ^ᵗᵗ t₂
            simp [eq]
        | inr red_r =>
            obtain ⟨t₂', h⟩ := red_r
            exists t₁.app t₂'
            exact Red.appᵣ h
    | inr red_l =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', h⟩ := red_l
        exists t₁'.app t₂
        exact Red.appₗ h
  case tapp σ' der ih =>
    right
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl val =>
        obtain ⟨_, t', h⟩ := val.canonical_form_tabs
        exists t' ^ᵗᵞ σ'
        simp [h]
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t', h⟩ := red
        exists .tapp t' σ'
        exact Red.tapp h
  case let' t₁ σ t₂ τ L der _ ih _ =>
    right
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl _ =>
        exists t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁
        simp
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', h⟩ := red
        exists t₁'.let' t₂
        exact Red.let_bind h
  case inl der _ ih =>
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl val => left; exact val
    | inr red =>
        right
        obtain ⟨t', h⟩ := red
        exists .inl t'
        exact Red.inl h
  case inr der _ ih =>
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl val => left; exact val
    | inr red =>
        right
        obtain ⟨t', h⟩ := red
        exists .inr t'
        exact Red.inr h
  case case t₁ _ _ t₂ _ t₃ _ der _ _ ih _ _ =>
    right
    cases ih rfl der with
    | inl val =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', lr⟩ := val.canonical_form_sum
        cases lr
        · exists t₂ ^ᵗᵗ t₁'
          simp
        · exists t₃ ^ᵗᵗ t₁'
          simp
    | inr red =>
        obtain ⟨t₁', h⟩ := red
        exists t₁'.case t₂ t₃
        exact Red.case h
  case sub => contradiction
  case abs σ _ τ L _ _ =>
    left
    exact ⟨LC.abs L, by simp [wf], by simp⟩
  case tabs L _ _ =>
    left
    exact ⟨LC.tabs L, by simp [wf], by simp⟩
